not_for: Data Scientists requiring big data analytics
target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: Individuals completely new to cloud-based software

prerequisites.required: Basic understanding of project or knowledge management needs
prerequisites.recommended: Familiarity with spreadsheet basics (for understanding databases)

system_requirements.hardware: Any PC, Mac, or Tablet with a modern web browser

overview.positioning: Master the all-in-one workspace tool to architect systems that manage your knowledge, projects, and team.
overview.short_description: Learn to build complex relational databases, automated workflows, and custom team workspaces in Notion.
what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Design intuitive page architectures and team wikis
Build complex relational databases with rollups and formulas
Integrate Notion AI to accelerate content creation and summarization
Automate Notion workflows using its API and native automations

why_now.industry_shift: Companies are migrating from fragmented tools (Docs, Trello, Jira) into unified workspaces like Notion.
why_now.ai_impact: Notion AI has embedded generative AI directly into the workspace, fundamentally changing how teams write and summarize.
why_now.business_demand: High demand for 'Notion Architects' who can build scalable systems for startups and agencies.
why_now.career_opportunity: Unique niche allowing professionals to consult or act as internal operational leaders.

learning_outcomes: ARCHITECT: Scalable team workspaces and company wikis
BUILD: Relational databases for project and CRM management
AUTOMATE: Repetitive tasks using Notion Automations and formulas
ENHANCE: Content generation and analysis using Notion AI

stages.name: Database Build
stages.desc: Creating backend data tables and relations

stages.name: Dashboard Design
stages.desc: Building frontend dashboards with linked views

stages.name: Onboarding
stages.desc: Creating templates and SOPs for team use

business_use_cases.business_problem: Information silos across different apps slowing down projects
business_use_cases.approach: Build a unified Company OS in Notion integrating wikis and task tracking

ai_integration.ai_can_assist_with: Drafting policies, summarizing meeting notes, brainstorming
ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: The architectural design of the workspace systems
ai_integration.responsible_use: Understanding data privacy settings for Notion AI

best_practices: Always separate backend databases from frontend dashboards
Use relations instead of duplicating data
Keep page permissions granular to protect sensitive data

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Treating Notion like a traditional folder system
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Use databases and tags instead of deep page hierarchies

career_paths.employer_expectations: Ability to streamline information access and project tracking
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: A portfolio of functional, aesthetically pleasing Notion templates

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Needs Analysis -> System Architecture -> Build -> Training
freelance_applications.portfolio_requirements: Publicly shared Notion templates demonstrating various use cases

assessment.criteria: System architecture logic, use of relations, and user interface design

certification.title: Certified Notion Specialist
certification.criteria: Pass the final system build assessment

not_covered: Custom programming for the API (only no-code automation is covered)

faq.question: Do I need a paid Notion account?
faq.answer: The free plan is sufficient for learning, though we will demonstrate paid features like Notion AI.

faq.question: Is Notion better than Excel for data?
faq.answer: Notion is better for qualitative data and text-based project tracking, while Excel remains superior for complex numerical analysis.

faq.question: Can I sell the templates I build?
faq.answer: Yes, many Notion creators sell their templates online, which we will briefly discuss.
